reviewer.scope: Same-session cross-agent code review of the replay UI against its core contract, followed by targeted regression verification

findings.description: Information-time frames hid unissued forecasts but exposed later-collected input prices, the flat anchor and their derived axis.
findings.reproduction: The real ETH origin frame evaluated 2026-10-26T00:00:00Z exposed 91 input prices and anchor 2326.75, although its complete input collection was 2026-10-26T12:12:46.363Z. Real BMNR and MSTR origin frames likewise exposed their later-collected inputs.
findings.fix: Asset inputs use the verified complete input acquisition boundary; BTC conservatively uses record issuance. Hidden inputs and flat values are absent. Frames with no visible prices have null domain and scale. The UI removes old SVG content, price datasets and pointer inspection and renders a price-free empty state.
findings.verification: Actual ETH, BMNR and MSTR regressions cover origin, one millisecond before collection, exact collection and issuance. BTC issuance gating and hidden-value absence in frame JSON pass. Integrated empty-state UI code was inspected.

findings.description: Generic replay prediction wording omitted that the original saved ETH path is one seeded random example and BMNR carries that example through conditional treasury valuation.
findings.fix: Identity retains pointMeaning, Korean pointLabel and the validated bandMeaning. The UI displays that interpretation in its disclosure, error explanation and provenance. Historical ETH identifies pointwise simulation medians and uncalibrated quantiles; historical BTC identifies the price-only shrunken-trend baseline.
findings.verification: Actual saved ETH and BMNR assertions preserve sampled-example semantics in exported identity while retaining every compared saved path value and output hash. Historical median and baseline meaning assertions pass. Integrated UI wording was inspected.

targetedVerification.data: The real dedicated ETH replay archive and preserved raw acquisition evidence were present in the parent worktree. This receipt does not assert that those data had already been committed when tests ran.
